request.text: An implant on WORKSTATION5 appears to have exported the domain's DPAPI backup keys. Contain host WORKSTATION5.theshire.local.

package.rationale: pgustavo's high-integrity PowerShell (PID 4380) ran whoami /user and then wrote ntds_capi_0_*.pfx, .pvk, .der and ntds_legacy_0_*.key into C:\Windows\System32 after reaching the domain controller's LSA RPC pipe: the domain DPAPI backup keys were exported (Mimikatz lsadump::backupkeys). Isolate WORKSTATION5 now.
